current: Warm services receive Reflex Cell outcomes today by a direct cell-to-service connection that bypasses any fabric, which is what this invariant forbids. qip-edge-node's MeshLink uplink publishes CellStateDelta - orders, fills and refusals, i.e. outcomes and decision data - straight to the central API's per-cell listener at QIP_MESH_PEER, and qip-api drains those deltas into Platform::ingest_cell_report on POST /cycle. It is true that no warm-service binary dials out to a cell (the cell is the client in both directions, so the cell serves no warm service), but the requirement is 'only through the fabric', and the only path that exists is not a fabric. ADR 0100 acknowledges the second route ('Until outcomes move onto the fabric for the central plane too, fills have two possible routes') and runs its first slice with the mesh uplink off. Neither end is deployed (execution_nodes = {} everywhere; QIP_MESH_CELLS set nowhere).

current: Model activation is announced today, by one producer, on a signed control payload - not on a fabric. Platform::model_manifest (backend/crates/runtime/qip-kernel/src/model_serving.rs:273) produces the trained_models slot (every promoted distillate by the digest a cell checks), and qip-api's pending_policy puts it on every cell's HMAC-signed PolicyPayload (backend/crates/apps/qip-api/src/mesh.rs:880, :973), which carries a strictly increasing per-cell sequence the cell uses as its anti-replay key. On the Reflex side, Cell::deploy refuses a plan whose inline model is not named in the verified manifest at its own digest (backend/crates/edge/qip-edge/src/cell.rs:2579, :2645 check_models_promoted), and qip-edge-node's strategies module deploys a compiled plan only if the file's bytes digest to what the verified payload's compiled_plan slot names (backend/crates/apps/qip-edge-node/src/strategies.rs:1-40). Issuance and promotion stay central by structure (architecture.rs no_edge_cell_can_issue_its_own_capital_or_promote_its_own_strategy). What is absent: no P0 fabric topic, offset or replay for the announcement; no Fabric Meta schema/ACL/producer-fencing admission; no distinct Release/Package Controller identity (the central plane signs with a symmetric HMAC key the cells also hold to verify, so 'by no other producer' rests on key custody and crate structure, not an admission authority); the centre produces no compiled_plan (package) announcement in non-test code; and policy activations are not announced as a separate record. Nothing is deployed (execution_nodes = {}; QIP_MESH_CELLS set nowhere).
